purpose: Keep a clean Unity runner from rejecting the formal native-4K packet before the deterministic scene rebuild has had a chance to establish the benchmark QualitySettings, camera, sun and LOD state.

initialPreflight.reason: ProjectSettings/QualitySettings.asset is not repository-authored on this branch, so clean-session QualitySettings before the generated benchmark rebuild are not evidence and must not be required to match the capture policy.

failureInjection: Launch from a clean editor session with default/low QualitySettings: contract-only preflight must not fail before the deterministic rebuild.
After rebuild set QualitySettings.shadowCascades != 4: prepared-baseline validation must fail.
After rebuild set QualitySettings.antiAliasing < 4: prepared-baseline validation must fail.
After rebuild alter the sole SummerSun direction or add a second directional light: prepared-baseline validation must fail.

visualFidelityGateMapping.lightingShadowsReflections: Expected positive impact only by making the intended VeryHigh 4-cascade shadow state reachable on a clean runner; no visual points without rendered evidence.
visualFidelityGateMapping.temporalLodAliasingStability: Expected positive impact only by making the intended MSAA/high-LOD/cross-fade state reachable on a clean runner; no visual points without rendered evidence.
